items.description: Positioned on the iconic Malecon, just five minutes from the historic Colonial Zone, Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo combines modern elegance with rich cultural experiences. With easy access to nearby beaches, shopping, dining, and the business district, we ensure an unforgettable stay in the heart of the city. Host meetings, weddings, and social gatherings in our 15 versatile event venues for up to 1,200 guests. Discover delicious dining experiences in our four restaurants and bars. Savor international cuisine at NABU, coffee and pastries at Kaffetto’s, mojitos and live music at Level 1 Bar, and tropical drinks and casual fare at Las Olas Pool Bar. Elevate your Caribbean stay with our exceptional amenities like our 24-hour Fitness Center, outdoor sparkling pool, spa services, casino, and free Wi-Fi. Offering 196 luxurious rooms with stunning ocean views, we ensure your stay in Santo Domingo is unforgettable.

items.description: Welcome to Vignette Casas del XVI, a boutique hotel in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, where every stay is lived differently. Located in the heart of the Colonial City, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, our hotel connects you with the rich history and culture of the Dominican Republic. Just a few steps away you will find the House of Columbus, the Ozama Fortress Museum, the National Pantheon and the First Cathedral of the Americas. Here we do not offer traditional rooms, but a collection of restored colonial houses with total privacy, authentic design and personalized service. Enjoy private pools, tropical courtyards, exclusive culinary experiences and airport transfers to Las Americas. Every space blends history, contemporary comfort and the warmth of the Caribbean for an intimate and unforgettable experience in one of the most fascinating destinations in the world. Discover Santo Domingo from within, living as if at house but with all the luxury and attention you deserve. Vignette Casas del XVI redefines hospitality in the Dominican Republic.

items.description: Tucked into the heartbeat of the Colonial City, Kimpton Las Mercedes Santo Domingo is where centuries-old history meets laid-back luxury. This one-time 16th-century schoolhouse now pulses with cultural energy and local soul. Step out our doors onto the cobblestone charm of Las Mercedes Street, where vibrant plazas, art-filled alleyways, and stories from the first city of the Americas invite you to linger and explore. Wander through nearby treasures like the Museo de las Casas Reales, the Alcázar de Colón, and Parque Colón, all just steps away. You’re walking distance to where The Godfather once filmed and where Dominican history continues to unfold in real time. Our neighborhood is a living museum and a lively destination, best discovered slowly, with curiosity and an open mind. Inside, you’ll find a sanctuary of calm. Every room tells its own story through local art and natural textures, while outdoor patios and vertical gardens offer space to breathe. Savor Northern Italian flavors at Zola, or keep it casual with international plates at El Patio. This is where world travelers and local trendsetters come to dine, connect, and feel inspired. From skyline-view spa tubs and a cigar lounge to thoughtful perks like our morning Kickstart and evening Social Hour, Kimpton Las Mercedes Santo Domingo blends design, culture, and human hospitality in a way that’s anything but ordinary.

items.description: Located in the heart of Santo Domingo’s Business District, the renovated Holiday Inn® Santo Domingo is ideal for business travelers. Top companies like Coca-Cola, Microsoft, and Unilever are minutes away offering convenient access for meetings and corporate events. Get free Wi-Fi, parking, a 24/7 Business Centre, and seven versatile meeting spaces. Explore popular nearby attractions, including Ágora Mall, Blue Mall, Quisqueya Stadium, and the National Botanical Garden. Our on-site restaurants offer delicious dining, along with cocktails during Happy Hour. Relax with amenities like a rooftop pool, Fitness Centre, and sauna. End your day in our spacious, pet-friendly suites with plush bedding and flat-screen TVs.

items.description: Nestled in the vibrant hub of business and entertainment, InterContinental Real Santo Domingo is situated in Piantini and the Financial District, just four miles from the Colonial Zone. Our hotel is conveniently located near key corporate centers, shopping, and dining destinations. Savor dining at our two unique restaurants and Blu Pool Bar, and relax in our spa. Enjoy stunning views from the roof deck terrace bar with infinity pool, overlooking the city.
